title: What's new: MCP Server (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Agent workflow - tables, schema, and queries

features.name: Find tables tool
features.description: A new system tool that enables agents to search for Business Central tables. The agent can provide search text to discover available tables in the system.

features.name: Table relations tool
features.description: A new system tool that helps agents understand how tables are connected to each other in Business Central, enabling the writing of proper join queries.

features.name: Table schema tool
features.description: A new system tool that allows agents to explore tables and see what fields are available on them.

features.name: Data query tool
features.description: A new system tool that enables agents to write and execute AL queries to retrieve and analyze data from Business Central tables based on user permissions.

features.name: MCP query data access without APIs
features.description: Agents can construct and run queries directly through MCP server tools without needing to use APIs. Data is returned based on permissions the user already has in Business Central.
caveats: Dependent on agent quality writing AL queries

features.name: MCP configuration UX improvements
features.description: New user interface for MCP configurations with a server features box that distinguishes between server features like the data tool and APIs, and shows which tools each feature enables.

features.name: MCP server security toggle
features.description: A new toggle in the copilot and agent capabilities page that allows administrators to activate or deactivate the MCP server feature as a whole.
